title: 基礎流体力学
subtitle: Basic Fluid Mechanics
keywords: Characteristics of fluid 2.Pressure 3.Equations of fluid flow 4.Momentum theorem 5.Contribution to local community, IoT
educationalGoal: Fluid mechanics plays a significant role in advanced mechanical systems and manufacturing. This course introduces the fundamental principles of fluid mechanics. Students learn the basic properties of fluids, Bernoulli's theorem, the equation of continuity, and the momentum equation. Students gain foundational skills in applying fluid mechanics knowledge to effectively use AI, machine learning, and advanced CAE through practical exercises.
advice: This course primarily introduces fluid mechanics. In particular, the flow of an ideal fluid, which is inviscid and incompressible, is discussed. Furthermore, the flow mechanisms of a real fluid are also explained. The contents and keywords of this course are as follows: 1. Characteristics of fluid and flow phenomena: Difference of solid, liquid, and gas, Dimension and Unit, Density, Viscosity, Compressibility and sound velocity, Steam pressure, Surface tension 2. Hydrostatics: Definition of pressure, Hydrostatic pressure, Manometer, Total hydrostatic force, Buoyancy force, Hydraulic pressure drive system 3. Basic equations of flow: Condition of flow, Representation method of fluid flow, Flow velocity, Flow rate and acceleration, Derivation of basic equations of flow 4. Bernoulli's theorem and equation of continuity: Derivation of equation of continuity, Application of equation of continuity, Derivation of Bernoulli's equation, Application of Bernoulli's equation 5. Momentum theorem: Momentum theorem, Application, Equation of angular momentum Detailed schedules and plans will be explained during the first week of classes. Additionally, some sessions will incorporate flipped classroom sessions utilizing pre-study materials via on-demand resources.
requiredKnowledge: The students must take a note in the class. The preparation and the review of the contents of the class must be done. Every class includes exercises and mini-examinations (quizzes). An attitude of willing action and learning is strongly required to the students.

activityGoals.body: Fluid characteristics such as compressibility and viscosity can be explained.
Relationship between fluid depth and pressure can be expressed and total hydrostatic force can be calculated.
Basic equations of fluid flow can be derived for easy examples.
Basic fluid flow can be calculated using the equation of continuity and Bernoulli's equation.
Momentum theorem can be applied to calculation of an actual fluid force.
Relationship between the course content and the local communities can be understood and discussed together.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Characteristics of fluids, especially compressibility and viscosity. (2) Total hydrostatic force and the relationship between the depth of fluid and static pressure. (3) Derivation of basic equations of flow. (4) Basic calculation of flow using the equation of continuity and Bernoulli’s equation. (5) Momentum theorem and its use for basic design problems in machinery that uses fluids. (6) Positive attitudes to questions and answers can be confirmed and the essence of flow phenomena can be discussed.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Characteristics of fluids, especially compressibility and viscosity. (2) Total hydrostatic force and the relationship between the depth of the fluid and static pressure. (3) Derivation of the basic equations of flow for easy examples. (4) Basic calculation of flow using equation of continuity and Bernoulli’s equation for easy examples. (5) Application of the momentum theorem to the calculation of fluid force. (6) Positive attitudes to questions and answers can be confirmed.
